verdict.rationale: HubSpot Workflows let users define trigger-based automation rules (e.g., on contact/deal property changes, events) that automatically execute actions like emails, CRM updates, task creation, and enrollment in sequences, and this is reinforced by webhook event subscriptions and AI agents that act automatically on signals. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of workflow trigger complexity and any AI-native (natural-language rule authoring) specifics beyond marketing copy.
